scope: Fresh real FFI, compiled/signed device packages, and actual Desktop-hosted Bot Remote Control across Android/iOS; no new cloud-inbox/sharing deployment

checks.claim: Create and configure an isolated Bot with a configured user-authorized Terra/Luna model
checks.functional: Create through normal UI; send prompt; observe actual assistant reply and selected model
checks.visual: As-launched window, Bot list/card, Bot detail and active conversation; smaller supported window

checks.claim: Owner devices reach the fresh signed Desktop host
checks.functional: Enable host and approve only the known Galaxy S25/iPhone; both load the same dedicated Bot
checks.visual: Desktop host/device status and each phone host/Bot list
checks.evidence: Both known approved phones connected by direct WebRTC to fresh signed host. New code comparison was not witnessed.

checks.claim: Real Android JNI callbacks drive Bot list/new chat and actual streaming reply
checks.functional: Create/send/reopen a Bot chat on Galaxy; Desktop observes the same thread and reply
checks.visual: Local Apps then Bots then sessions heading; ready/running/idle states
checks.evidence: android-terra-live.json: actual echo, Back/reopen, cold restart reconnect and shared Desktop history

checks.claim: Real iOS FFI delivers Bot list/chat/reply and survives navigation and cold launch
checks.functional: Mobile MCP with Terra completed actual Luna echo and Back/reopen; Desktop observed same thread. Cold start displayed unrelated local resume error, then system alert and device disconnect blocked remote reopen.
checks.visual: ios-terra-echo.png shows actual assistant; iOS composer AX Auto conflicts with Desktop Ask; follow-up recorded.

checks.claim: Remote human action requests stay associated with their Bot conversation
checks.functional: Ask configured model to request a safe workspace action and an explicit user question; act from phone; observe pending state and completion on Desktop
checks.visual: Pending action, question choices/answer, resolved Bot status
checks.evidence: Real phone AskUserQuestion A/answer/final marker synchronized with Desktop. Safe printf completed automatically; approval/denial prompt not exercised.

checks.claim: Interrupted work and transport changes recover without duplicate turns
checks.functional: Cancel only a dedicated test turn; background/reopen viewer and cycle host availability; send a follow-up after recovery
checks.evidence: Android cold reconnect and recovery echo pass. Stop interrupts turn; shell becomes background task and completes. Process kill not established; iPhone cold reconnect incomplete.

checks.claim: Bot Remote Control off immediately revokes viewer access and can be restored
checks.functional: Disable only the dedicated Bot; viewer loses Bot access; reenable and reopen persisted conversation
checks.visual: Unavailable state, removed/reappearing Bot row, preserved chat
checks.evidence: Dedicated Bot disappears when off; opened thread Send disabled, test prompt never persisted, draft cleared. Reenable restores history and empty composer.

checks.claim: Relevant Bot controls and conversation remain usable at actual device/window sizes
checks.functional: Viewport and region bounds after relevant interactions; short exploratory normal-input pass
checks.visual: Inspect desktop initial/smaller window, Bot list/detail/chat and phone list/chat/action states for clipping, occlusion, text contrast and stable layout
checks.evidence: Desktop1320x860 and renderer900x600 inspected; no horizontal overflow and composer within viewport. Android real screens inspected. iOS echo visible but permission label discrepancy unresolved.

real_model: Bot model openai-chatgpt/gpt-6-luna as explicitly selected. User-requested GPT-6.1 Terra is the automation agent.
blockers: iPhone physical automation connection is intermittent; remote cold-start reopen not completed
iOS remote composer AX shows Auto while Desktop same-thread controls show Ask; root cause not yet established
